verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy question for a government filing service that collects entity and filer data, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no user-facing retention settings, deletion requests, or data-lifecycle policy. The only nearby items are a saved-session ID and a Long Form Certificate listing all documents ever filed, and neither gives users control over retention or deletion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
